reasoning_traces.think:
Phase 4 introduces a dual transformation: from passive pick delivery to active skill development. Calibration training uses Bayesian belief updating to align user confidence with empirical outcomes, forming a core GSI primitive. The Edge Lab expansion provides a suite of computational kernels that operate on stochastic processes, enabling users to simulate and optimize strategies—this maps directly to GSE’s state-space exploration. The Model Court conversational layer enables dynamic feedback loops between user queries and model outputs, creating a feedback-driven inference engine. These primitives collectively define a closed-loop system where user behavior informs model evolution, and vice versa. Failure modes include overfitting in calibration, divergence in simulations, and semantic drift in dialogue systems. Each primitive must maintain integrity under adversarial input and scale with increasing data volume.
